beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Six days after graduating dead last, Naruto Uzumaki is doing the Hokage's paperwork. All of it. With two hundred copies of himself.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, this report just stops in the middle of a sentence. Is that normal?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Yeah. Read the next one.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Twenty years of mission reports. Every ambush. Every mistake. Every ninja who never came home. And he'll remember all of it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Because every shadow clone sends its memories back when it pops. That's not a what-if. In canon, nobody tells Naruto until he's sixteen.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: So this isn't a power-up story. The rule is simple. He does not get stronger. He gets to read first.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: That's six days from now. Tonight he's twelve, filthy, and alone in a forest with a stolen scroll. And he's about to read one more line.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Midnight. A clearing deep in the forest. Naruto has a hundred bruises and, at last, one perfect clone.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Okay. Okay! Look at that. It even has my stupid face.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: That's my stupid face! Boss, we did it!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: They grin at each other. The clone steps back to celebrate, and the root behind him doesn't step back.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa—

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Pop. Ten feet away, Naruto yelps and grabs his own knee. It's scraped raw.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Ow. Wait. I didn't fall.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He looks down. Under the hand seals, in cramped brushwork, there's a note he was about to roll right past.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Shadow Clone Jutsu was invented by the Second Hokage, Tobirama, for scouting enemy ground. Naruto learned it in a few hours.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The note is six lines long. What the clone learns, the caster keeps. For this reason the technique is forbidden. The mind fails long before the chakra does.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: So everything he learns, I learn. Everything.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: A twelve year old with more chakra than anyone alive has just found a cheat code. Four years early.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He doesn't celebrate. He runs an experiment. One clone, the next page of the scroll, and a long walk around a tree.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Pop me when I'm done. I wanna see if it works!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Reading, reading. Ooh, this seal is nasty. Okay, I see how it works.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto pokes him with a stick. Pop. And he knows the seal. Not read it. Knows it.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Wait. I can be in two classes at once.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Ya know what? I can be in all of them!

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Naruto! There you are! Do you have any idea what you've done?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Mizuki-sensei? You said if I learned one jutsu from this, I'd pass!

beats.speaker: MIZUKI
beats.text: Give me the scroll, Naruto. You've done exactly what I needed. It was never meant for a fool like you.

beats.speaker: MIZUKI
beats.text: Twelve years ago the Nine Tails destroyed this village. And you're the fox, Naruto. Everyone knew but you.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Mizuki hurls a giant shuriken at the boy. Naruto can't move. It never lands. Iruka is over him, the blade buried in his own back.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto goes very still. Iruka, bleeding, doesn't look at the boy at all. He looks at Mizuki.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: He's not the demon fox. He's Naruto Uzumaki of the Hidden Leaf. And he's my student.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Mizuki charges. Naruto answers with the one jutsu he learned tonight. The clearing fills with a thousand of him.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Come on, Mizuki! Pick one! Pick any one!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Mizuki goes down under a mountain of orange. Then the clones disperse, and a thousand memories come home at once.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The same moment, from a thousand angles. Mizuki's fist. The moon. And Iruka's face, crying, a thousand times over.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The first person who ever chose him. And Naruto gets to keep every single copy.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He drops to his knees and is sick in the grass. Iruka thinks it's chakra exhaustion.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Easy. Breathe. You overdid it, that's all.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: It's not that, sensei. I just saw your face. A thousand times.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Close your eyes, Naruto. I've something for you.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Congratulations. You graduate.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: That's your headband. You can't give me your headband!

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: I can get another one. You only graduate once.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Nobody ever stayed to see me finish anything.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Then I'll stay for the next one.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Everyone else remembers one graduation night. Naruto gets to remember it a thousand times.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Morning. He should be asleep. Instead he's on the Academy roof with twenty clones, testing the rules.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Rule one. The knowing comes back. The muscles don't. Skill yes, strength no.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Okay, rule three. A clone that gets hit pops. So who's gonna get punched?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Not me. I got punched last time.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: You're the same person!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Then it doesn't matter who!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Somebody gets punched. Pop. On the roof, Naruto winces for a face that isn't his. Rule three, confirmed. He keeps the hit.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Okay. We all feel it. Nobody gets punched twice!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Rule four. Every clone carries a share of my chakra.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Then why do I feel hungry?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Because we're all hungry. We're one stomach.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Rule four he underlines twice. Every clone carries a share of his chakra. And his chakra has a lodger.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Rule two is less funny. Every clone's tiredness comes back too, all at once. Fifty clones for an hour is a fifty hour headache.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. One hour. Everyone pops at the same time, right?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: That's the plan.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: That's a terrible plan.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Everybody dispel on three!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Wait. Is it on three, or after three?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: It's on three! Why is that hard?!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He tries it anyway. Fifty clones, one hour, all dispelled together. Naruto is unconscious for nineteen hours.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Ugh. Why is there a crow on my chest?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Okay. Batches. Batches of ten.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Right. Every class I ever slept through. Everything I missed. Go!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Twenty clones take notes in the back of every classroom. Somewhere a teacher wonders why his worst student has so many cousins.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The library throws him out. He's that boy. So thirty clones walk back in, transformed into thirty different old men.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Good afternoon, sir. Where might I find the chakra control primer?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: What a coincidence. I'm also looking for that book.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: One librarian notices that all thirty old men are reading the same beginner's primer. Four of them are holding it upside down.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then leaf exercises, times two hundred. And he finally learns why his clone jutsu always failed.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: It was never too little chakra! It was way too much, shoved through a pinhole!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Two hundred clones, ten hours each. That's two thousand hours of practice a day. Most genin don't train that much in a year.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: That evening Iruka takes him to Ichiraku, the way he does when he's worried. Naruto orders his usual and, for once, chews with his mouth closed.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Eat slower. Nobody's going to take your bowl.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Old habit.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Quick question, Naruto. Who founded the Hidden Leaf?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Hashirama Senju and Madara Uchiha. Then the Second Hokage, Tobirama. Who invented my jutsu, by the way.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Say that again. Slowly.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Naruto. Where did you learn all this?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Everywhere. Mostly the library. They're really nice there, once you're old.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He knows which shops will serve him, and at what hour. He knows people by their footsteps, because nobody ever walked toward him.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the tower above, the Third Hokage watches it all in his crystal ball, pipe in hand.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: His left hand has formed a cross seal on the desk. He doesn't seem to notice. It's an old habit.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Two thousand hours a day. Hm. That explains the librarian.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He isn't angry. He's doing the same arithmetic. And looking at the paperwork on his own desk.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The summons comes at dawn. Naruto walks into the Hokage's office braced to be yelled at.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Old man, I can explain! Okay, I can't. But I learned a jutsu, so technically I passed, ya know!

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Stealing the Scroll of Seals is a crime, Naruto. The sentence is one month of filing duty in my archive.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Unclassified mission reports only. Every shelf, every box.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Filing?! I'm a ninja now!

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Then file like one.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: A month? Old man, I could do a month in a day.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: I know. That's rather the point.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Can I at least have a lunch break?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: You may have an hour. Your clones may have the next five.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: First, a staff form. Name, office, position. Paperwork, Naruto. Get used to it.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Fine. Filing clerk. Naruto Uzumaki. Where's the punishment part?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: You're standing in it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It's the first official form that has ever carried his name, and he signs it twice by accident.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Third's reasons are two. Keep the boy where the old man can see him.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And let a lonely child be, for once, inside the building instead of outside the window.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Day one. Two hundred Narutos enter the archive. It is, structurally, a fire hazard.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Pass it down! Pass it down! Do not drop it, it's older than us!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Why is there a stamp on your forehead?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: He needed a flat surface!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: I found a portrait of somebody very old. Where does it go?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: With the other old things.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: That's the Third Hokage.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Do not say that out loud!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, where do I put the Hokage's hat?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Under H!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: For Hat or for Hokage?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Yes! Both!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: By noon, a bucket chain of clones is passing scrolls from the basement to the third floor, out one window and in through another. Nobody tells them there are stairs.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: By night, the Third Hokage's in tray is empty. For the first time in thirty years.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Old man! Your in-tray's empty. What do we do now?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: I don't know. That has never happened.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Is that my desk? I'd forgotten it was wood.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Years from now, as Seventh Hokage, Naruto will run this same office with shadow clones. He's just starting early.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then the mail desk. Diplomatic letters from every hidden village, sorted by hand and filed by date.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, why does the Fourth Kazekage sign like he's stabbing the page?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: He presses so hard the brush splits. Look at every downstroke!

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Ha. He has always been a hard man. File it under S for Sand.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Old man, can I keep that letter? It's the best thing I've ever read.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: No. It's a diplomatic document.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Worth a shot.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto thinks it's the funniest thing he has read all week. He files it under S, and moves on to the next.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: As punishments go, it is a strange one. Nobody has ever handed Naruto a key before.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the second day, the Third Hokage walks past the archive door and counts forty Narutos reading in complete silence. He keeps walking. Then he walks back to check.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: By the fourth day, it stops being funny. Mission reports aren't stories. They're after-action reports.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Every ambush that worked. Every formation that failed. Every report that ends in the middle of a sentence.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. Three separate reports on one cat. The last one just says, never again.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: File them under tragedies.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, here's one where the cat bit a chunin. Pretty hard.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Respect the cat.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Every ambush has the same shape. They always hit the last man first.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: So we put somebody useless at the back.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Nobody's useless at the back. Put somebody who's paying attention.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Look. Three teams were hit on the same road. Always the same corner.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: So somebody should have checked the corner.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Somebody did. They wrote it down. Nobody read it.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. Why does nobody read these?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: 'Cause it's easier to be brave than to be prepared.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, two reports disagree about the same fight.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Then one of them was scared, or both were. Read both.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. This one is signed by somebody who never came back.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Read the names out loud. Somebody oughta.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Two hundred voices read them aloud, quietly, one after another. Nobody has done that for any of them.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Most genin learn from one teacher. Naruto is learning from every shinobi who ever came home. And a few who didn't.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He goes quiet. For the first time in his life, Naruto Uzumaki isn't the loudest person in the room.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. C-rank escort. The last line says, puddle on the road, no rain for a week.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Mark that one. Don't ask me why. It just feels like a sentence that's got a second half.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He starts to read what isn't there. One week in October, twelve years ago, where every file is in a different clerk's handwriting.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, that whole shelf is marked off limits. By the Third himself.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Off limits. Huh. Leave it. For now.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Naruto, it's midnight. Go home.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: One more shelf, sensei. Please.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Are all of those you?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Yes. Do not tell the old man.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Naruto. The old man signed your form. He knows.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then, on the sixth day, a clone in the back corner finds a thin folder. Kakashi Hatake. Jonin instructor evaluations.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi Hatake has never passed a team. Every genin he ever tested went straight back to the Academy.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, every one says the same thing. Failed. Could not work together.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: And eleven reports say Kakashi Hatake arrived late. Eleven.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: So he's late a lot. So what?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: No. Look at the dates.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Huh. Same dates. Every year. Nobody's that unlucky.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He writes the dates in the margin of his notebook. Then, because tomorrow is team assignments, he turns the page.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Most students walk into a test with a pencil. Naruto will walk in with the teacher's whole file.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Team Seven. Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura. Their jonin instructor, Kakashi Hatake, orders them to the training ground at dawn for a survival test. No breakfast.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi Hatake will not be there at dawn. He is late to everything.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto knows. It's in eleven reports. Which gives him the training ground, three hours, and two hundred clones.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: By the time the others arrive there are fourteen wires, six trenches, and one very confused squirrel.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, the squirrel is still in the net.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Leave him. He's a witness.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Why are you standing in a ditch?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Listen, both of you. It's a teamwork test. He's failed every team before us. I know 'cause I filed the paperwork.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: You're dead last. Why would I believe you?

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Nobody knows what the test is, Naruto. And honestly? You're annoying. Why would I trust you?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Because I've never lied to you. Okay, three times. This isn't one of them.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: If this goes wrong, I'm blaming you.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Fair. Blame me. I'll be right next to you.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: I don't need a team.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Good. Me neither. I just need you to listen.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Knowing the answer is useless if nobody will listen. The obstacle was never power. It is trust.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Fine. Here's the deal. Whatever bells we get, you two take them. I'll be the one who goes back to the Academy.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I just need two of us to pass.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Naruto. You would really do that?

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Hm. Fine. Stop talking and show me the plan.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi strolls in, book open, and finds three genin waiting in a perfect triangle. He turns a page.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Sorry I'm late. I got lost on the road of life.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Two bells. Three of you. Whoever has none goes back to the Academy. Begin.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Come at me with the intent to kill. It's the only way you'll ever touch me.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Is he serious? He can't be serious.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: He's serious. Get ready.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Nobody moves. Then Sasuke opens with a fireball, and Kakashi, for the first time today, has to move.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He lands on a wire Naruto strung at dawn. Sakura's kunai cuts it, and a log swings in.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi dodges the log, then the kunai, then the second log nobody told him about. He's still holding the book. He's no longer reading it.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Not bad. Whoever planned that.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then Sasuke throws a windmill shuriken. Kakashi sidesteps it, bored. And the shuriken is Naruto.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In canon, Naruto pulls this exact trick on Zabuza, months from now. He's just early.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: A hand closes around a bell. Kakashi's one visible eye goes wide.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Wait. Who taught you that?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: A lot of me.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Sasuke. Catch.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: You're giving it to me?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I said I would. Two of us have to pass.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: You'd hand over your own bell? Then all three of you pass.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Already?

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: It's the first time I've said that. Do not ruin it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It's the first team Kakashi Hatake has ever passed. He does it in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: That was actually kind of smart, Naruto.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I know. I read it somewhere.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Same time tomorrow. Do not be late.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: You're the one who's always late.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Right. Fair point.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Every team before them failed. This one passed because one boy had read the file.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: That night, Kakashi stands in the Hokage's office, and for once he doesn't open with a joke.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: They passed. First try. Ten minutes.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Congratulations, Kakashi. You're finally a teacher.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: That wasn't a compliment, was it?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Not entirely.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Tell me. How did Sasuke take it?

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: He called him a loser. Then he said thank you. Quietly, so nobody would notice.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Progress.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Lord Third. What exactly have you let him read?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Only what any clerk reads. Forms. Receipts. Reports. He asked politely.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: A beat passes. Then another. The Third Hokage studies his pipe as if it has just told a clever joke.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Two in the morning. The archive is empty, except for one filing box that isn't a filing box.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It's a clone. Naruto left him behind, transformed, to finish the shelf marked off limits.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Do not breathe loudly. Do not breathe at all. You're a box.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Rule one, touch nothing. Rule two, touch everything. Rule three, don't get caught.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The off-limits shelf. Twelve years of dust. And one box where a clerk in a hurry filed the wrong sheet. A hospital roster. Medical leave, October, twelve years ago.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: It's alphabetical. One line's inked out. Above it, Uzuki. Below it, Yakushi.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Somebody blacked out the name. Nobody thought to re-alphabetize the page.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: I've filed the whole clan registry. Exactly one name fits between Uzuki and Yakushi.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He has written that name on every form he has ever signed in his life.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: The leave ends October tenth. That's my birthday.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Authorized by the Fourth Hokage.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The clone pops. Across the village, Naruto sits bolt upright in bed, holding a memory he never lived.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Breathe. It's only a clone's memory. It's just a clone's memory.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Uzumaki. There was another one.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Deep under the seal, in the dark behind the bars, one enormous red eye opens.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.text: A thousand of you, brat. And every one carries a piece of me. Did you think I wasn't reading too?

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.text: Her name was Kushina. I should know. I lived in her before I lived in you.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Before Naruto, the Nine-Tails was sealed inside a woman named Kushina Uzumaki. That part is not a what-if.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In Part Two, a twelve year old asks the Third Hokage one question, and the old man has to decide whether to lie to a thousand witnesses.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Old man. Who was Kushina Uzumaki?

stamps.label: CANON
stamps.note: Created by the Second Hokage for scouting.

stamps.label: CANON
stamps.note: He does this in the Land of Waves.
